opportunity_cost_check_2026-09-07.question: do bear positions block bull triggers (one-position rule), making bear ACTIVELY costly rather than dead weight?
opportunity_cost_check_2026-09-07.data: automation/state/core-decisions.jsonl NOT_FLAT ticks (522) deduped to 201 distinct blocked triggers, joined to journal/trades.csv open intervals (safe+bold)
opportunity_cost_check_2026-09-07.verdict: DEAD -- blocking is always same-side (ribbon gating means bull triggers do not fire while a bear position is open). Bear is dead weight, NOT actively costly. The 86 same-side blocks are re-triggers of an already-held move, not lost trades (adding is the C31 killer).
